incident.cause: Three copied CPU seal templates correctly substituted the Pod name, producer receipt, output path, and terminal schema, but retained one stale literal in the seal() step argument.

recovery.validation: All three replacement manifests were self-digest valid and matched their exact optimizer step, checkpoint path, source plan, world size 8, and 33-file inventory; gpu_reload_verified remained false.

durable_repair.rule: Render the source run, Pod name, source receipt, checkpoint directory, output manifest, terminal schema, and seal() argument from one requested step, then revalidate those exact command bindings before server preview or create.

acceptance_boundary: This receipt records a zero-GPU operator-template failure, the successful CPU-only replacement seals, and a local fail-closed repair. It does not claim GPU reload, promotion, evaluation, or capability improvement.
